title: Triage Indicators of Malicious Activity
prompt: Classify each indicator into the corresponding attack family.

items.label: Outbound UDP traffic spike to a single IP address
SMS message urging the recipient to click a delivery link
500 failed login attempts across 200 different accounts
Unknown process connecting to a newly registered domain
DNS query to a high-entropy domain

explain: The family is determined by the observed artifact, not by severity. A single incident can produce indicators across multiple families.
